model: Silver Series STN104 Airflow / Temperature Transmitter (RS-485 network version)
applies_to: EBTRON Silver Series STN104 network transmitters (RS-485: BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU or JCI N2) for airflow, differential pressure and temperature.
summary: The STN104 is the RS-485 network version of the EBTRON Silver Series STx104 transmitter. On BACnet MS/TP it reports airflow, differential pressure and temperature as analog inputs, with writable analog values for the duct free area and the baud rate.
notes: Objects and writable properties come from Tables 5 and 6 of the manual. Units of the analog inputs are writable (Units property).
Table 5 also lists a binary value "Auto Baud Rate Detection" but no instance is printed for it, so it is left out.

source.title: Silver Series STx104 Transmitter - Installation, Operation and Maintenance Technical Manual

integration.summary: Read airflow (AI 0), temperature (AI 2) and differential pressure (AI 1). Write the duct free area to AV 0 so airflow in CFM or LPS is right.
setup: Ships with network address 1. For BACnet MS/TP the ADDRESS DIP switches set the MAC (1-127); switch 1 at power-up controls whether the device instance is set to the same value and the BACnet objects reset to defaults.
MS/TP ships at 76,800 baud; write the Baud Rate object (AV 1) for 9600, 19,200 or 38,400.

points.name: Airflow
points.description: Units FPM, CFM, MPS or LPS

points.name: Pressure
points.description: Differential pressure; units in. H2O or Pa
